games.name: Paradox [RELEASE]
games.desc:
This game may prove to pose a learning curve in the higher ranks, and has little hand holding for new players.

If you have bought the emote gamepass, please make sure you rejoin if you were already in game just in case, and then you can just hit K to open up the menu.

Controls:
Left Click - M1
R - Critical
F - Block / Parry
Q - Dash
Shift - Run
Left Alt - Shiftlock
B - Grip
G - Carry
V - Activate Special
M - Open Menu
N - Meditate
Comma - Show NPCS in range
Right Click - Feint Flashstep/Dash/M1
